paite: Huchiin siampu lian Eliasib a unau siampute toh a thou ua, belam kongpi a bawl ua; a hihsiangthou ua, a kongkhakte a tung ua; Meah insang tanin ahihsianghtou ua, Hananel insang tanin.
english: Then Eliashib the high priest rose up with his brothers the priests, and they built the sheep gate; they sanctified it, and set up its doors; even to the tower of Hammeah they sanctified it, to the tower of Hananel.

paite: Huan amah zomin Jeriko miten a lam uh. Huan amau zomin Imri tapa Zakkurin a lam hi.
english: Next to him built the men of Jericho. Next to them built Zaccur the son of Imri.

paite: Huan Hassena tapaten ngasa kongpi a hih ua; a inkamte akhung ua, a kongkhakte a tung ua, a kalhnate leh a kalhnatawnte.
english: The sons of Hassenaah built the fish gate. They laid its beams, and set up its doors, its bolts, and its bars.

paite: Amau zomin Uria tapa, Hakkoz tapa, Meremotin a bawl phaa. Huan amau zomin Mesullam Berekia tapa, Mesezabel tapain a bawlpha. Huan amau zomin Baana tapa Zadokin a bawlpha hi.
english: Next to them, Meremoth the son of Uriah, the son of Hakkoz made repairs. Next to them, Meshullam the son of Berechiah, the son of Meshezabel made repairs. Next to them, Zadok the son of Baana made repairs.

paite: Huan amau zomin Teko miten a bawlpha ua; himahleh a miliante un a Toupa uh nasepna ah a nakpan nuam kei uhi.
english: Next to them, the Tekoites made repairs; but their nobles didn’t put their necks to the work of their lord.

paite: Huan kongpi lui pen Pasia tapa Joiada leh Besodeia tapa Mesullamin a bawlpha ua, a inkamte a khung ua, a kongkhakte a tung ua, a kalhnate leh, a kalhnatawnte.
english: Joiada the son of Paseah and Meshullam the son of Besodeiah repaired the old gate. They laid its beams, and set up its doors, and its bolts, and its bars.

paite: Huan amau zomin Gibeon mi Melatia leh Meronoth mi, Jadon, Gebeon mite, Mizpah mite, luipi khena ukpipa laltutphah toh kizomten a bawl hoih ua.
english: Next to them, Melatiah the Gibeonite, and Jadon the Meronothite, the men of Gibeon, and of Mizpah, repaired the residence of the governor beyond the River.

paite: Huan amah zomin Harhai, dangkaengsekmite, tapa Uzzielin a bawl hoih a. Huan amah zomin gimlimbawlmite tapa Hananiain a bawl hoiha, kulhbang ja tanphain Jerusalem a bubitsak uhi.
english: Next to him, Uzziel the son of Harhaiah, goldsmiths, made repairs. Next to him, Hananiah one of the perfumers made repairs, and they fortified Jerusalem even to the broad wall.

paite: Huan amaute zomin Jerusalem seh kim khata vaihawmpa, Hur tapa Rephaiain a bawlphaa.
english: Next to them, Rephaiah the son of Hur, the ruler of half the district of Jerusalem, made repairs.

paite: Huan amau zomin Harumaph tapa Jedaiain, amah in sun hialin a bawlphaa. Huan amah zomin Hasabnei tapa Hattusin a bawlpha a.
english: Next to them, Jedaiah the son of Harumaph made repairs across from his house. Next to him, Hattush the son of Hashabneiah made repairs.

paite: Malkija Harim tapa leh, Hasub Pahath-moab tapain a mun dang leh meipi insang a bawlpha uh.
english: Malchijah the son of Harim, and Hasshub the son of Pahathmoab, repaired another portion, and the tower of the furnaces.

paite: Amah zomin Jerusalem seh kimkhata vaihawmpa, Hallohes tapa Sallumin, amah leh a tanute toh, a bawlpha ua.
english: Next to him, Shallum the son of Hallohesh, the ruler of half the district of Jerusalem, he and his daughters, made repairs.

paite: Guam kongpi pen Hanun leh, Zanoaha tengten a bawlpha ua, a lam ua, a kongkhakte a tung ua, a kalhnate leh, a kalhnatawnte leh, ekvum kongpi lama kulhbang tong sang khat toh.
english: Hanun and the inhabitants of Zanoah repaired the valley gate. They built it, and set up its doors, its bolts, and its bars, and one thousand cubits of the wall to the dung gate.

paite: Huchiin Beth-hakkerem seha vaihawmpa, Rekab tapa Malkijain ekvum kongpi a bawl hoiha; a lama, a kongkhakte, a kalhnate leh, a kalhnatawnte a tunga.
english: Malchijah the son of Rechab, the ruler of the district of Beth Haccherem repaired the dung gate. He built it, and set up its doors, its bolts, and its bars.

paite: Huan Mizpah seha vaihawmpa, Kol-hoze tapa Sallumin tuikhuk kongpi a bawl hoiha; a lama, a vuka, kongkhakte, kalhnate, leh kalhnatawnte leh, kumpipa huan kianga Sela dil bang, David khopi akipana suk pai leichial tanin a bawl hi.
english: Shallun the son of Colhozeh, the ruler of the district of Mizpah repaired the spring gate. He built it, and covered it, and set up its doors, its bolts, and its bars, and the wall of the pool of Shelah by the king’s garden, even to the stairs that go down from the city of David.

paite: Amah nungin Beth-zur seh kimkhata vaihawmpa, Azbuk tapa Nehemiain, David hante toh kimat mun leh, bawlsa dil chiang leh, mi hatte in chiang tanin a bawlphaa.
english: After him, Nehemiah the son of Azbuk, the ruler of half the district of Beth Zur, made repairs to the place opposite the tombs of David, and to the pool that was made, and to the house of the mighty men.

paite: Amah nungin, Levi mite, Keilah seh kimkhata vaihawmpa Asabiain, amah seh a diing in a bawl hoiha. Levi mite, Bani tapa Rehum-ten a bawlpha ua. Amah zomin Keilah seh kimkhata vaihawmpa, Hasabiain, amah seha dingin a bawl hoiha.
english: After him, the Levites, Rehum the son of Bani made repairs. Next to him, Hashabiah, the ruler of half the district of Keilah, made repairs for his district.

paite: Amah nungin a unaute uh, Keilah seh kimkhata vaihawmpa, Henadad tapa Bavaiin a bawl hoiha,
english: After him, their brothers, Bavvai the son of Henadad, the ruler of half the district of Keilah made repairs.

paite: Huan amah zomin Mizpah vaihawmpa, Jesua tapa Ezerian, seh dang, kulhbang kawina taka galvan in tana pai touhna sunin a bawl hoiha.
english: Next to him, Ezer the son of Jeshua, the ruler of Mizpah, repaired another portion, across from the ascent to the armory at the turning of the wall.

paite: Amah nungin Zabbai tapa Barukin seh dang, kulhbang kawina akipan siampu lian Eliasib in kongkhak chiang a bawl hoiha.
english: After him, Baruch the son of Zabbai earnestly repaired another portion, from the turning of the wall to the door of the house of Eliashib the high priest.

paite: Amah nungin Hakkoz tapa Uria tapa Meremotin seh dang, Eliasib in kongkhak akipan Eliasib in tawpna chiang a bawlphaa.
english: After him, Meremoth the son of Uriah the son of Hakkoz repaired another portion, from the door of the house of Eliashib even to the end of the house of Eliashib.

paite: Amah nungin, phaijang mite, siamputen a bawlpha uh.
english: After him, the priests, the men of the Plain made repairs.

paite: Amau nungin Benjamin leh Hasubin a in pha un a bawl hoih ua. Amau nungin Anania tapa Maaseia tapa Azariain amah in sikah a bawl hoiha.
english: After them, Benjamin and Hasshub made repairs across from their house. After them, Azariah the son of Maaseiah the son of Ananiah made repairs beside his own house.

paite: Amah nungin Henadad tapa Binuiin seh dang, Azaria in akipan kulhbang kawina tan, leh a ning chiang, a bawl hoiha.
english: After him, Binnui the son of Henadad repaired another portion, from the house of Azariah to the turning of the wall, and to the corner.

paite: Uzai tapa Palalin kulhbang kawina sun chiang a bawl hoiha, kumpipa in tungnung jaw akipana hong ding khe tou insang, venna pisa kianga om toh.
english: Palal the son of Uzai made repairs opposite the turning of the wall, and the tower that stands out from the upper house of the king, which is by the court of the guard. After him Pedaiah the son of Parosh made repairs.

paite: Amah nungin Paros tapa Pedai leh tempul nasem Ophela tengteng suahlam pang tui kongpi leh insang lawkkhia jawn tan a bawlhoih uh.
english: (Now the Nethinim lived in Ophel, to the place over against the water gate toward the east, and the tower that stands out.)

paite: Amah khitin Teko miten seh dang, Ophel kulhbang chiang phaa, insang thupi dingkhe tou sunin a bawlpha ua.
english: After him the Tekoites repaired another portion, over against the great tower that stands out, and to the wall of Ophel.

paite: Siamputen sakol kongpi tunglam, michihin amah intung sun chiatin a bawlpha ua.
english: Above the horse gate, the priests made repairs, everyone across from his own house.

paite: Amaute nungin Immer tapa Zadokin amah intung sun tou chiang a bawlphaa. Amah nungin suahlam kongpi ngakpa Sekania tapa Semaiin, a bawlphaa.
english: After them, Zadok the son of Immer made repairs across from his own house. After him, Shemaiah the son of Shecaniah, the keeper of the east gate made repairs.

paite: Amah nungin Selemi tapa Hanani leh Hanun Zalaph tapa guknain seh dang a bawlpha uh. Amah nungin Berekia tapa Mesullamin a dantan tung jawn a bawlpha hi.
english: After him, Hananiah the son of Shelemiah, and Hanun the sixth son of Zalaph, repaired another portion. After him, Meshullam the son of Berechiah made repairs across from his room.

paite: Amah nungin dangkaengsekmite tapa Malkijain Nithinimte in leh, sumsinmite in chiang, Hammipkad kongpi jawn chiang leh, a ninga kahtouhna chiang a bawlpha hi.Huan a ninga kahtohna leh belam kongpi kikal dangkaengsekmite leh sumsinmiten a bawlpha uhi.
english: After him, Malchijah one of the goldsmiths to the house of the Nethinim, and of the merchants, made repairs over against the gate of Hammiphkad, and to the ascent of the corner.

paite: Huan a ninga kahtohna leh belam kongpi kikal dangkaengsekmite leh sumsinmiten a bawlpha uhi.
english: Between the ascent of the corner and the sheep gate, the goldsmiths and the merchants made repairs.
